# Bundled VimTeX

Source: https://github.com/lervag/vimtex

Commit: `bd0788f13c23337dae815e21f1f283cb79753ac7`

Unmodified runtime files and documentation from the locally available upstream checkout.
Only runtime directories, README, and MIT license are bundled. Tests, website, Git
metadata, screenshots and development tooling are omitted.

Requires Neovim 0.12.4 or newer. See LICENSE.md.
